title: Engineering Requirements for Generative AI Agents: The BARD Process Theory
abstract: arXiv:2610.29741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How teams engineer requirements for systems built around Generative AI (GenAI) Agents remains empirically uncharted. Existing Requirements Engineering (RE) research mainly addresses AI and ML-based systems broadly but provides no process account for agentic systems, whose non-deterministic behavior cannot be anticipated at design time. To understand how teams actually proceed, we applied Socio-Technical Grounded Theory across 36 semi-structured interviews with practitioners, interleaving data collection and analysis so that emerging findings drove our theoretical sampling and shaped successive rounds of coding. The result is Behavioral Agent Requirement Discovery (BARD), the process theory of RE for GenAI Agents. BARD holds that requirements are not fixed up front but discovered through a recurring cycle of four activities: teams scope the need, build the agent, observe its behavior, and revise what they ask for. translated_title: 生成式AI智能体的需求工程：BARD过程理论
translated_abstract: 团队如何为围绕生成式人工智能（GenAI）智能体构建的系统开展需求工程，在实证上仍是未知领域。现有的需求工程（RE）研究主要针对广义的人工智能和机器学习系统，但尚未为智能体系统提供过程性论述——这类系统的非确定性行为无法在设计时被预知。为了解团队的实际做法，我们采用社会技术扎根理论（Socio-Technical Grounded Theory），对从业者进行了36次半结构化访谈，并将数据收集与分析交替进行，使新出现的发现驱动我们的理论抽样，并塑造后续的编码轮次。研究成果是行为智能体需求发现（BARD），即面向GenAI智能体的需求工程过程理论。BARD认为，需求并非预先固定，而是通过循环往复的四项活动周期被发现：团队界定需求范围、构建智能体、观察其行为，并据此修订他们所提出的需求。通过这个四阶段
tldr: 该研究通过对36位从业者访谈的扎根理论分析，提出了面向生成式AI智能体的需求工程过程理论BARD，指出智能体需求并非预先固定，而是通过“界定范围—构建智能体—观察行为—修订需求”这一循环周期被持续发现。
en_tdlr: Through a grounded theory study of 36 practitioner interviews, this paper proposes BARD, a process theory of requirements engineering for GenAI agents, showing that requirements are not fixed upfront but discovered through a recurring cycle of scoping the need, building the agent, observing its behavior, and revising the requirements.
